item.title: Trump urges Putin to end 'military aggression' in Europe
item.description: US President Donald Trump said Thursday he had asked Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression" against Europe, in a shift in tone towards the leader Russian he called his friend just a week ago. Trump said he had made the request to Putin when they met in China last week, adding that he thought it would help lead to a deal to end Moscow's grinding war in Ukraine. The US leader's comments come a day after he hosted NATO chief Mark Rutte in Florida, after which they issued a joint statement calling on Russia not to expand the Ukraine war. FRANCE 24's international affairs editor Kethevane Gorjestani explains.

item.title: France's Bardella faces new allegations of anti-Semitic comments
item.description: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Thursday faced new accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager, after French media published extracts from previously unaired conversations online. The 31-year-old top ally of French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has denied any wrongdoing after allegations emerged in September that he made conspiracist comments about Jewish people on Facebook in 2013. FRANCE 24's Solange Mougin reports.

item.title: Le Pen slams push for EU budget deal before French election
item.description: EU leaders locked horns over the bloc's budget at a summit meeting in Brussels on Thursday, as far-right leader Marine Le Pen slammed an "underhanded" push to lock in the long-term spending plans before French presidential elections next year. European Council head Antonio Costa turned up the pressure upon arrival at the budget talks, where heavyweight Germany is pressing for cuts as well as burden-sharing on money for Ukraine. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels.

item.title: Marie-Antoinette’s porcelain ‘nipple bowl’ fetches record $3.1 million at Paris auction
item.description: A "jatte-teton", or nipple bowl, that once belonged to French Queen Marie-Antoinette fetched a record €2.9 million ($3.1 million) at Paris auction Thursday. The breast-shaped porcelain bowl was one of four such pieces which King Louis XVI once ordered for his queen's royal dairy creamery.

item.title: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella faces fresh allegations of anti-Semitism
item.description:
The leader of France's far-right National Rally party, Jordan #Bardella, is facing fresh accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager.
On Thursday, November 26, French media outlets Mediapart and Le Monde published new excerpts from private Facebook conversations dating back to 2013.
